summary: A Claude subagent's tool calls and background task notices attach to the Agent/Task call that started it, live and after a reload, and every client shows one collapsible row per subagent with its status, folded steps and report.

automated: tests/fixtures/subagent-cases.json (labels, grouping, rows) runs in vitest (tests/unit/subagent-steps.test.ts) and in the Android SubagentStepsFixturesTest.

All new fields are optional, so no migration: stored tool rows keep parentToolCallId and isError inside their tool_calls JSON, and notices keep the tool-use id inside their text. An older backend sends none of them; the phones then keep every step where it was (tests/unit/mobile-subagent-rows.test.ts, Android SubagentFeedRowsTest). The Expo change is JavaScript only, so it ships as an OTA.

tests/unit/subagent-row.test.ts drives the desktop row in jsdom: collapsed behind a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, toggling, the failure in the row, the failing step's output, the folds and the report.
Visual regression screens subagents and subagents-expanded (two parallel subagents, one done, one failed) in Dark, Light and Translucent; the screens phase passed twice without updating.
Android: ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin lintDebug passed, including Robolectric render tests of the row.
notExercised: No live Claude subagent run through this build; the adapter mapping is tested against recorded SDK message shapes.
Android on-device tests (connectedDebugAndroidTest) were not run; no emulator was started.
The Expo row was tested with jest only, not on a phone.
Codex and OpenCode are not mapped: Codex runs a spawned agent as its own thread, and OpenCode's ACP stream carries no child-session updates.
Runs of top-level background notices (the parent's own) are not folded; only a subagent's notices fold.
